items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for Monday Night vs Dallas.
items.why: Official Saturday injury report ruling.
items.implication: AJ Brown and Goedert see boosted targets/routes vs DAL.
items.opportunity: AJ Brown target share spike; Eagles WR2/3 hierarchy elevates.

items.text: Lamar Jackson downgraded to OUT for Sunday vs Bengals with high ankle sprain; third straight miss, Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: Downgraded Saturday after limited practice and optimistic comments.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Ravens pass game and Zay Flowers/Mark Andrews volume impacted negatively.
items.opportunity: Backup QB opportunity; fade Ravens skill if relying on Lamar dual-threat.

items.text: ETR Sunday injuries dump: Q Lamar/Puka/Breece/Baker/Rico Dowdle/etc; OUT Evans/Deebo/Adams/Rice/Love/Montgomery/Egbuka/Warren/Charbonnet/BRob; IN Jacobs/Judkins/Addison/Hock/etc.
items.why: Compiled official/practice reports for Sunday slate.
items.implication: Major role changes; monitor GTD for Qs.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries for OUTs (Bijan full load, Kittle funnel, Walker/Charbonnet reverse, etc); Jacobs/Judkins cleared.

items.text: Love Saquon if active vs DAL (efficient prior, great RB matchup); Breece if plays vs MIA goes in lineup despite Stephania caution (GTD).
items.why: Return efficiency + matchups.
items.implication: Must-start if active.

items.text: If Puka Nacua (calf) can't go, Stafford hierarchy: Higbee lead, then Mumpfield/Parkinson/Atwell/Whittington/Allen. McVay: majority practice Thu, felt power/explosion loss, test pregame.
items.why: Calf minor per McVay/Rap; GTD.
items.implication: TE heavy if out (prior 37% TE share w/ Puka out + Adams LT).

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK (w/ Caleb): 30% TS, 19.2 PPR/g, 6+ rec/60+ yds both games since Williams return.
items.why: Usage spike with Caleb.
items.implication: Strong TE start.
items.opportunity: High target share/routes in CHI offense.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring); 49ers DvP inflates opp RB +4.4% (7th), recent RB catches high (White/Holani/Harvey/Love); sweet full-load setup for Bijan vs SF.
items.why: BRob listed out; usage data + DvP.
items.implication: Bijan bellcow carries/targets/RZ.
items.opportunity: Full snap/route share expansion for Bijan.

items.text: Kittle will go nuts: awesome player/scheme + 49ers entire WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo out). Not National TE Day bump.
items.why: WR injuries funnel targets; scheme.
items.implication: Elite TE1 ceiling vs ATL.
items.opportunity: High routes/targets/RZ with WRs out; CMC slot temptation noted separately.

items.text: Luther Burden 68.8% routes, elite 2.56 YPRR; Kmet IR season-ending reduces 2/3-TE sets, more juice for Burden.
items.why: Kmet to IR (Johnson quote); route/YPRR data.
items.implication: Burden target/route rate up in CHI.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed facility meetings/lifting/medical (non-football); Lloyd/Johnson backups poor EPA; long-term outlook discussed. Schefter: activated, expected to play.
items.why: Facility access + activation.
items.implication: Likely plays @DET; monitor workload post-layoff.
items.opportunity: Lead back if full; Berry hates due to layoff.
items.conflict: Berry HATE on Jacobs workload post-layoff

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% snaps last 3 weeks; downgrade.
items.why: Snap share collapse.
items.implication: Limited fantasy viability; Rhamondre lead.

items.text: Puka out prior: Rams 37% TE target share NFL-lead; Adams LT out too so TEs (Higbee > Parkinson short-term; Ferguson stash) again.
items.why: Historical usage w/ Puka absent + Adams injury.
items.implication: TE streamers if Puka sits.

items.text: Love AJ Brown: 97% routes, 33% TS (led team) Week 6 despite 3 catches=3 drops/27 yds on 10 tgts; buying the volume/matchup @CHI.
items.why: Elite route/TS despite inefficiency; Bears D.
items.implication: WR1 upside bounceback.

items.text: Love Jaylen Warren @NO, Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @CAR: big workloads, friendly matchups (RBs carve those Ds); hate Jacobs (layoff), Skattebo, Wilson.
items.why: Workload + matchup data.
items.implication: RB2/flex strong plays; fade Jacobs.
items.conflict: Levitan notes Jacobs facility access positive

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for Monday night vs Dallas.
items.why: Official ruling on Saturday injury report.
items.implication: AJ Brown and Goedert target spikes; Eagles WR depth tested with Saquon also Q.

items.text: Lamar Jackson downgraded to OUT for Sunday vs Bengals with high ankle sprain; third straight miss. Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: High ankle sprain; official downgrade confirmed by Schefter and Rapoport.
items.implication: Ravens offense downgrade; Huntley starts; Flowers/Henry usage may shift in less efficient attack.

items.text: Sunday outs include Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel, Davante Adams, Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Zach Charbonnet, Brian Robinson. Schefter full list corroborates.
items.why: Official Friday/Saturday designations; coach confirms (Evans, Love).
items.implication: Handcuffs/backups and teammate spikes (e.g. no Monty for Houston RBs; no Rice/Adams).
items.opportunity: Role expansion for remaining skill players and handcuffs.

items.text: Puka Nacua (calf) questionable, will test pregame per McVay; if out Stafford hierarchy is Higbee, Mumpfield, Parkinson, Atwell, Whittington, Allen. Berry notes prior Puka-out TE share hit 37%.
items.why: Calf; felt lack of power/explosion; majority practice Thursday then held Friday; pregame workout.
items.implication: Major DFS/slate pivot if out; TE-heavy targets likely.
items.opportunity: TE target share spike (Higbee lead); Adams already long-term out.

items.text: Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs from exempt; expected to play Sunday at Detroit. ETR listed IN; Levitan noted facility access (meetings/lifting/medical) and poor backups (Lloyd/Johnson EPA).
items.why: Activated; expected to play per Schefter/Rapoport.
items.implication: Workload return after layoff; Berry ranks lower/hates due to rust questions.

items.text: Loves Saquon Barkley if active vs Cowboys (efficient prior, great matchup); will start Breece Hall if active vs Miami despite Stephania caution.
items.why: Saquon limited practice returning from hamstring; Breece quad Q; both high upside if cleared.
items.implication: Immediate lineup locks if active.

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK with Caleb: 30% target share, 19.2 PPR/game, 6+ rec and 60+ yards both games since return.
items.why: Usage spike with Caleb Williams return; Kmet now IR adds more.
items.implication: TE1 upside weekly.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring). 49ers D inflating opposing RB production +4.4% (7th-most); recent RB catches high. Sweet full-workload setup for Bijan Robinson.
items.why: BRob ruled out; SF conceding RB receptions (White/Holani/Harvey/Love examples).
items.implication: Bijan full workload vs soft RB DvP.
items.opportunity: Carries + receiving work; goal-line/ dual-threat role expansion.

items.text: Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel OUT. Kittle will go nuts due to scheme + entire WR corps hurt (not National TE Day). CMC tempted for more slot work amid WR injuries; rare buy on RB-as-WR statements given Kaelon Black and dire situation.
items.why: Evans Achilles/ribs OUT (Shanahan/Rap confirm); Deebo hamstring OUT; WR injuries force funnel.
items.implication: Kittle massive target spike; CMC receiving upside elevated.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to TE and CMC slot; red-zone funnel.

items.text: Cole Kmet to IR season-ending knee (Johnson confirm). Luther Burden only 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR; Kmet absence reduces 2/3-TE sets, giving Burden more juice.
items.why: Season-ending knee; carted off prior game.
items.implication: Burden route/target share increase with Caleb.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown: 97% routes, 33% target share in Week 6 despite drops/yards; buying the usage vs Bears.
items.why: Elite route/target share; Bears matchup good for yardage.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; volume secure even if Smith out.

items.text: Texans activated WR Tank Dell to active roster; set for first NFL action in nearly two years Sunday. ETR had as Q/IN.
items.why: Officially activated; season debut.
items.implication: Potential target competition or upside in HOU offense; monitor snaps.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% of snaps over last three weeks. Clear downgrade in role.
items.why: Snap share collapsed to 21% L3W.
items.implication: Not a reliable fantasy starter; committee/backup role.

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs (workload question after layoff vs DET) and Rome Odunze (shadowed outside by Gonzalez; low prior ceilings).
items.why: Jacobs rust/layoff; Odunze tough CB matchup and inconsistent.
items.implication: Fade or lower rankings.
